items.title: Can Kraft Heinz (KHC) Use Europe To Refresh Its US Product Line?
items.summary: Kraft Heinz (NasdaqGS:KHC) is using its European operations as a testing ground for health-focused products aimed at reshaping its U.S. portfolio. The company is drawing on consumer trends in Europe to guide reformulation and development of more health-conscious packaged foods. Management plans to apply successful European product concepts to the U.S. market as part of a broader effort to refresh its domestic lineup.
